name: @builderforce/agent-tools
description: Runtime-agnostic agent tool contract shared by the cloud (Worker) and on-prem (Node) engines. The package ROOT is node-builtin-free (the Worker imports it); node-only helpers live behind `./node-path`, `./node-symbols`, `./node-git-ignore`, and `./node-desktop` export conditions, which the Worker never imports. `./node-tree-sitter` is the symbol index's tree-sitter extractor (web-tree-sitter + tree-sitter-wasms grammars, loaded lazily; the regex extractor is the fallback), re-exported from `./node-symbols`. `./node-research` is the Node half of `local.research` (file fingerprints + the persisted answer cache).
